q: The connection between information complexity and communication complexity: the information complexity IC(f) is defined as the minimum information that must be revealed about the inputs during a communication protocol. It satisfies:
opts: IC(f) ≤ CC(f) and IC(f) = lim_{n→∞} CC(f^n)/n (amortised communication complexity equals information complexity)
exp: Information complexity IC(f) is the amortised communication complexity: CC(f^n)/n → IC(f) as n → ∞. Always IC(f) ≤ CC(f) ≤ O(IC(f) · log n). Braverman's theorem (2012): the amortised complexity equals the information complexity. This gives a direct connection between entropy and communication.
